title: Handoff Sherpa: AE/CS Weekly Sync — Lucia Navarro
content:
Quick purpose: prep notes for my weekly sync with AE (Marco) and SE (Jenna) — primary goal: align on BrightWave renewal strategy + finalize next-step owners. Informal scratchpad — I will triage and copy finalized action items to the account playbook after the call.

Key context (one-liners):
- Customer: BrightWave Media (mid-market adtech) — Redwood usage: hosted API + one dedicated pool.
- Current ARR: ~$420k, committed for Dedicated next quarter pending renewal negotiation.
- Renewal window: 2026-05-15 (formal contract end) — decision target: 2026-04-30.
- Risk signals: 20% drop in token usage month-over-month; mobile app saw 35% latency spike in Feb; support SLA tickets increased (S-2x last 45 days).

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick status (5m): adoption metrics + top risk items I/O
2) Technical blockers (7m): Jenna to summarize latency findings + short-term mitigations
3) Commercial posture (8m): Marco to share renewal ask range and discount guardrails
4) Negotiation tactics (5m): discuss pilot vs. committed capacity options + incentives
5) Action review & owners (5m)

Pre-read notes for AE/SE: (send before call)
- Latest latency dashboard link (Console): /accounts/brightwave/dashboards/latency — highlight 99p increases on mobile region
- Usage trend sheet (Drive): brightwave-usage-q1-2026.xlsx — show per-product token delta
- Support ticket summary (sheet tab): top 5 bugs impacting generation pipeline

Talking points (what I want to hear / validate):
- Jenna: root cause hypotheses for mobile latency spike; ETA for fix if infra-side or model-side (cache miss vs. batch config?)
- Marco: will customer accept a 6–9 month Dedicated commit as bridge vs annual? What renewal discount will leadership approve for a short-term commit?
- Both: appetite for pilot of Redwood Optimize recommendations (KV caching + smaller batch windows) as low-cost risk reduction incentive

Open questions to surface live:
- Is the usage drop seasonal or tied to specific creative experiments? (If seasonal, what % do we expect to recover?)
- If we propose a 6-month commit, can billing change mid-term if usage rebounds (true-up clause)?
- Can CS own a light onboarding play for mobile SDKs with SE support (2–3 sessions) to reduce token churn?

Risks & mitigation (my quick scoring):
- Risk: Performance regressions driving churn — HIGH
  - Mitigation: priority SE triage + temporary autoscale bump for mobile region for 2 weeks, offer short-term credits for impacted tokens
- Risk: Price sensitivity on Dedicated commit — MEDIUM-HIGH
  - Mitigation: offer staged commit (6 months with option to extend to 12) + attach Optimize pilot to show cost savings
- Risk: Exec attention misalignment — MEDIUM
  - Mitigation: schedule exec briefing w/ product ROI slide (Marco to propose dates)

Draft negotiation levers (internal):
- Technical incentives: free Optimize pilot (30 days), 2 SE-led tuning sessions, access to extra observability retention for 90 days
- Commercial incentives: 8–12% discount for annual commit; 3–5% discount for 6-month bridge + commitment to expand in Q4; waived onboarding fee if sign by 2026-04-15
- Non-discount levers: SLA addendum for mobile region, quarterly ROI review w/ executive sponsor

My proposed ask for the meeting (what I will propose verbally):
- Offer: 6-month Dedicated commit (baseline X GPUs, estimated throughput 250 req/s) with a 30-day Optimize pilot and two technical sessions; if metrics recover by month 5, convert to 12-month at X-10% price.
- Deadline: need verbal intent by 2026-04-20 to commit infra ramp for May start.

Immediate action items to assign after sync (draft):
- Marco: draft customer-facing renewal email + proposed pricing options (due 2026-03-17)
- Jenna: run targeted mobile region flamegraph + quick cache health check; report by 2026-03-16
- Lucia (me): prepare Optimize pilot scope doc + ROI slide deck for exec briefing (draft by 2026-03-15)
- Aisha: pull historical usage correlation for campaign launches (deliverable: one-pager by 2026-03-18)

Notes-to-self during call (shortcuts):
- If Marco pushes for deeper discount, pivot to offer Optimize pilot + longer term SLA instead of percent off
- Confirm which internal budget owner approves discounts >10% (likely VP Sales)
- Capture direct customer quote on why they saw latency (we can use as signal for product team)

Follow-up (post-call):
- Convert action items above into Jira tasks (CS board) and tag 'renewal-brightwave-2026'
- Update account playbook in Drive and share with Marco + Jenna
- Schedule executive briefing week of 2026-03-22 if customer receptive

Stuff to archive/clean after deal closes:
- Move this scratch doc to shared_drives/customer-success/brightwave/notes/ with final label and rename to 'renewal-negotiation-log-2026.json'

Random ideas to test (brainstorm):
- Offer a 30-day 'token forgiveness' window where spike-related tokens are credited back up to a cap — might reduce emotional churn
- Run micro-benchmark with a quantized model variant on mobile payloads to show consistent latency improvements (SE + applied-ml partner task)

End of scratchpad. I'll polish and push official action list to Jira post-meeting.
